items.name: 常规·剑·T1·武器
items.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / precise-object redesign.
Asset type: one production transparent equipment icon for a chibi adventure RPG, replacing gear-standard-sword-t1-weapon.
Input images: image 1 is the old 324-icon library to be redesigned; it supplies item identity only, not its ornate style. Image 2 is the approved current simple sword icon, the positive line-and-color reference. Image 3 is the approved simple coat icon, the same style reference. Image 4 supplies the game's actual chibi character style only; do not include its scenery, UI or characters.
Primary request: redraw ONE complete STANDARD SWORD, T1 basic stage. Practical starting adventurer equipment: a broad straight blue-grey steel blade with one large pale bevel, a very short rounded brass crossguard, a chunky dark-brown leather grip and round brass pommel. Keep the recognisable chibi hand-drawn look, but give this baseline sword a distinct simple straight silhouette that future modular square omega and natural bone/wood primal swords will visibly depart from. It should be functional, friendly and compact.
Style: rounded silhouette, soft dark warm charcoal/brown contour, matte flat colour, only TWO or THREE large shade planes, no glossy render, no micro filigree. At 32px it must immediately read as a sword; at 48px the short plain guard and simple blade must be unmistakable.
Composition: one isolated complete physical weapon, diagonal lower-left grip to upper-right blade tip, centred, generous transparent margins, visible object about 78–82% of square canvas. Keep the entire point and pommel. No background, floor, external cast shadow, frame, label, text, numbers, aura, particles, second weapon or badges. Preserve genuine alpha transparency.
Material/palette: soft slate steel, warm ivory bevel, muted apricot brass and brown grip matching the positive references. Not the heavily ornamented, skinny, tiny-gem art from the old library.
Output is a single standalone production PNG icon, not a sheet or a display card.

Series priority: PRIMAL items must have their working body made from visibly curved BONE and bent ROOT/WOOD. Main palette is warm IVORY BONE, walnut wood, tan cloth and small AMBER or moss details; family colours are at most a tiny accent. No steel breastplate, steel blade centre, conventional leather-strapped knight shoulders, diamond jewel mounts or regular gear with vines pasted on it. Rebuild the whole outer silhouette as a grown organic wearable. Use broad arcs, open branching supports and organic asymmetry.
Use case: style-transfer / equipment redesign.
Asset type: ONE standalone transparent production game equipment icon, gear-primal-staff-t1-weapon.
Input images: game character and simple sword are positive cartoon DRAWING-STYLE references only; do not copy the sword steel material or old library silhouette.
Subject: one complete LONG staff; long narrow shaft about two thirds of total length, small upright crystal held in an open forked top; unmistakably longer than a wand.
Family identity across all six pieces: tall narrow rhombi, vertical structures and open forked supports.
Series palette priority: warm ivory bone, walnut roots/wood and tan cloth, with a small family-colour accent. No steel or conventional metal working body.
Series: PRIMAL -- warm ivory bone, bent dark wood/root, matte mineral/amber accents and woven leather/cloth; equipment has a naturally grown curved construction: smooth curved bone/wood pieces form the working body, open branching or curled joints and organic asymmetry. It must have a distinctly organic outer silhouette, not regular gear with two twigs pasted on it; no skull face, gore, aura or ornamental thorn clutter. The three series must be visibly different in their outer contour and material construction, even in greyscale.
Stage: T1 BASIC: one uncomplicated main structural layer; modest single fitting. Keep a plain compact contour with a short/simple guard or support. Armour has a simple vest/robe body, small shoulders; helmet has a low/simple crown; boots have simple cuffs; jewellery has one small readable mount.
Style: soft warm charcoal/brown outline, chunky rounded object proportions, matte hand-drawn colour blocks, TWO or THREE large shading planes, warm restrained highlights. Keep details broad and legible. Match the new simple chibi items, not the skinny ornate old library.
Composition: diagonal lower-left grip to upper-right functional end, complete and not cropped. Centred on a square transparent canvas, full object visible, longest visible extent roughly 78–82% of canvas, generous equal safety margin. Do not enlarge T3 beyond the common size.
At 32px the equipment part must read immediately; at 48px the family, series and stage must be recognisable by structure. Each icon depicts a coherent physical wearable or weapon, not a pasted symbol.
Constraints: genuinely transparent alpha; ONE isolated object (a pair only for boots). No background, floor, external cast shadow, frames, labels, text, numbers, rarity tags, characters, particles, glowing discs, tiny filigree or dense shiny rendering. Do not generate a sprite sheet or collage. The output is one production PNG.
